nodes.summary: The integer indicator that a natural number is even.
nodes.title: Even indicator of a natural number

nodes.summary: The coefficients of the even-indicator expansion: one at zero and `(-1) ^ i * 2 ^ (i - 1)` at positive indices.
nodes.title: Coefficients of the even-indicator expansion

nodes.summary: A product of even-cardinality indicators and parity signs is congruent to its finite subset expansion cut off at total degree `M`. Each even-indicator factor costs at most one power of two, so the cutoff must satisfy `ν - 1 + #J₁ ≤ M`, with `1 ≤ ν`. Indices outside `J₁ ∪ J₂` select only the empty subset.
nodes.title: Truncated subset expansion of parity products modulo powers of two

nodes.summary: Summing parity coefficients over all subsets gives the even-cardinality indicator.
nodes.title: Subset sum of parity coefficients is the even-cardinality indicator

nodes.summary: Twice the even indicator is one plus the parity sign.
nodes.title: Twice the even indicator is one plus the parity sign

nodes.summary: Twice the parity coefficient is the sign coefficient, with a correction at zero.
nodes.title: Twice a parity coefficient is a sign coefficient

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
